numeric_learning.structure: same rule applied to every bit position independently (2 inputs per bit)

explanation:
file_compute: learned state transformation
  shape: 2 operand(s) of W bits -> W bits
  vector program (state example search), disassembled from its tensors:
    r0 = input x0
    r1 = input x1
    r2 = zero
    r3 = one
    r4 = zero
    r5 = zero
    @0: r4 = observe(r0)
    @1: r5 = combine(r1, r4)
    result = r5
  learned from 2 training cases and 2 validation cases; 2 steps, 328 candidates
scope: straight-line reuse of learned arithmetic and typed state procedures
